READ-ONLY BRANCH RETIREMENT / LIVE DEPENDENCIES — ROUND 434
Date: 2026-10-14 (Asia/Tokyo)
Scope: identify live path dependencies, preservation steps, and candidate local worktrees/branches for the user's requested pruning. This is a cleanup plan, not a cleanup run.

Boundary
Main's 9055 official bulk benchmark is active. I did not inspect, modify, or query its run outputs and did not query GPU/process/environment state. I read its explicitly named report-registry-v199.json only. No Git mutation, cleanup, build, test, or source edit occurred. The only write is this report.
Incident: one broad source-path search used an insufficient '*.log' exclusion and accidentally returned unrelated older benchmark .txt log matches outside the active bulk worktree. I stopped immediately and did not intentionally inspect or retain those excerpts. This is a read-scope violation; no active bulk WT file was searched. All subsequent investigation used explicit code/report/cache/symlink paths.

Registry and report-reference policy
The supplied registry v199 is SHA256 c1b89eb35685504e20aed9da73e83533122e7ee98329a98f7b83fa2ab56894c3. It records 1001 completed research entries, no new reports, and prior registry v198 at feat-layer-major-phase4k-stock-bench/report-registry-v198.json (SHA256 ca62d3fd47e378b70a21ac15ef8a5947bc49ad736b881acb88d277a677019f48). R432 and other recent source-only reports live under /home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007/research-20261009, outside removable worktrees. They may keep historical worktree paths as provenance. A path string does not require retaining a checkout: record the canonical repo, commit SHA, file SHA/source pins, and status. For clean committed source, retain a Git ref/bundle only if the commit would otherwise become unreachable; otherwise rev:path remains recoverable. For uncommitted future drafts, save and hash the diff/source snapshot before pruning. Worktree path provenance and Git object reachability are separate retention decisions.

Current true dependency blockers
1. Intel LLVM 7.1.1 runtime and lint assets. Multiple existing non-active CMakeCache.txt files (phase4k, phase-cache stock, native-copy diagnostic, and sync-xe build) store absolute CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER/CMAKE_C paths under /home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install/bin. Reusable .lint symlinks in many Strata worktrees point through that WT to /home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-b570-prefill-publication-20261011/.lint. These are local ignored/untracked tool assets, not recoverable from removing Git refs. Before deleting either WT, relocate the exact .tools/intel-llvm-v711/install tree and .lint directory to stable non-worktree tool paths, retarget retained .lint links, and either reconfigure retained CMake caches to the new compiler path or deliberately discard/recreate those build dirs. Preserve package-lock/checksums/offline download assets if offline lints are required. Keep both dependency WTs until relocation and a non-GPU path-resolution check is completed by Main after benchmark close.
2. ggml checkout. Several CMakeCache files set STRATA_GGML_DIR=/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/.worktree/dep-ggml-3cf-xe-e32-20261011. That worktree is at commit 3cf03257f219afbe7334045ff7c6a06ac68c627d, and the separate durable /home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/ggml-sycl-pinned checkout is already at the same commit. The minimal resolution is to reconfigure any retained caches to ggml-sycl-pinned; until then deleting dep-ggml breaks incremental builds. Its commit is also present under the llama.cpp repo's master ref.
3. oneMath archive. The local cache is inside sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite's build tree at build/contrib-llvm/_deps/strata_onemath-subbuild/strata_onemath-populate-prefix/src/xestrata-3.tar.gz (1,584,608 bytes; SHA256 9a5203102002e5e85f1ad4a8b91b9f6134365f016bba1a430b038df95517e61d). CMakeLists.txt names the immutable MistVVK oneMath tag URL xestrata-3.tar.gz and can fetch it again. The archive is not a Git-source dependency. Move it to an external cache only if future builds must be offline; otherwise retire it with its build tree.
4. Profile. diag-sycl-prefill-service-events/data/expert-profile.bin has SHA256 8f59b4aa8873209dff11c11e37bcda9529a1335b724a1afeea37bf6388975baf, exactly matching both the main Strata repo data/expert-profile.bin and the current /home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl/data/expert-profile.bin. This copy is redundant; no branch/worktree is needed to retain the profile.
5. Upstream pristine U. Niko1221/Strata/.worktree/bench-upstream-v0143-pristine-20261012 is at 7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d, which is reachable from Niko repo origin/main. No current CMake path points to it. Its pristine worktree/branch is removable after no active compare controller needs its checkout; the source revision remains reproducible by commit.
6. Strata sync skill. Current project skill path /home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl/.agents/skills/strata-upstream-sync is a symlink into yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-strata-upstream-sync-skill-20261013/.agents/skills/strata-upstream-sync. No stable /home/yayoi/.agents/skills/strata-upstream-sync copy exists. Removing that WT breaks the active skill path. Copy/publish the skill to a durable user skill root or stable checked-in location and retarget the symlink first. The WT is clean at 97f8b40ca99ec298c24d7ecc7b270e530d43194d; its ref is independently reachable from other refs, but files are a physical symlink target.

Future worktree set to retain until Main consolidates/qualifies it
- Active 9055: feat-layer-major-bulk-upload-20261013 — do not touch until its owner closes it.
- Qualification/source baseline: feat-layer-major-phase4k-20261013, clean HEAD 9c83ea6ba02a562d55cd90ae678aadebc2b88ae2. This is the reviewed P/4K source baseline and was the parent of current qualification work. After 9055 closes, retain its commit/source pins, not necessarily its worktree; first establish a durable named source ref/snapshot and verify no next qualification depends on the checkout path.
- Physical full-context work is not one interchangeable branch. Keep feat-layer-major-phase-full-context-probe-20261013 (dirty, 14 changed files; HEAD 8b48d17c99b70d32781f9f5b056602a598a37b1c) as the future 262144 phase probe candidate, and keep feat-phase-native-head-lease-20261013 (dirty, 18 changed files) until Main confirms the full-context branch contains/replaces its head-lease ownership changes. The two worktrees have divergent hashes for overlapping expert-cache/session/generate source; do not delete the head-lease draft based only on the similar branch names.
- Route union: diag-layer-route-union-census-20261013 is dirty (4 tracked files plus new header/test from R432) and is the explicit union plan.
- Decoder D: diag-bounded-decode-route-ledger-20261013 is dirty (3 source files) and is the explicit decode ledger plan.
- Adapter: feat-serve-first-row-adapter-20261013 is dirty (4 files) and explicit adapter plan. Keep feat-serve-first-row-logits-capture-20261013's dirty producer implementation and feat-fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013's clean parent commit until Main decides they are adapter prerequisites or folds them into one durable branch; R382 describes the standalone adapter as lacking a production producer. Do not remove the comparator commit while the adapter worktree is based on its HEAD.
- feat-layer-major-phase-cycle-20261013 has a clean source commit and a separate lifecycle report. It may be retired after Main confirms its source contribution is wholly carried by the selected physical phase branch; preserve its source commit/ref if report reproduction requires it.
- fixed-history multirow comparison captures are a different producer contract from serve-first-row. R421 explicitly says the adapter cannot consume fabricated multirow Prefill metadata. Preserve only the current named comparison fixture/capture required by Main's follow-on; don't leave an entire worktree just because an external report mentions its old path. Do not retire the last current fixture before recording its hash/consumer/review point.
